name: The Unavailable row badge on the My Bookmarks page: viewer's bookmark on a video of the 'Movies 2' library (seeded by bookmarks-page-probe.mjs as 'page-probe unavailable'); the admin takes 'Movies 2' out of viewer's libraries (the whole policy posted back with EnableAllFolders false), and viewer's page then shows the group as Unavailable with the placeholder instead of the poster (no Items/{id}/Images request), its name unlinked, the row's play disabled and no scissors, and the same row in the flat view; the admin gives the library back and the poster is requested again. The users change hands by signing out in the drawer and in again without a reload (as users-viewer.json does); viewer's policy is restored here and, whatever happens, by the probe's finally.

steps.name: sign in as admin
the Bookmarks script ran
viewer, the libraries, and viewer's seeded bookmark
steps.script: const users = await ApiClient.getUsers(); const viewer = users.find(u => u.Name === 'viewer'); const folders = await ApiClient.getVirtualFolders(); const movies2 = folders.find(f => f.Name === 'Movies 2'); if (!viewer || !movies2) throw new Error('no viewer or no Movies 2 library'); return { viewerId: viewer.Id, enableAll: viewer.Policy.EnableAllFolders, enabled: viewer.Policy.EnabledFolders, movies2: movies2.ItemId, others: folders.filter(f => f.Name !== 'Movies 2').map(f => f.ItemId) };

steps.name: viewer can see every library to begin with
take Movies 2 out of viewer's libraries (the whole policy, EnableAllFolders false)
steps.script: const user = await ApiClient.getUser(__vars.setup.viewerId); const policy = Object.assign({}, user.Policy, { EnableAllFolders: false, EnabledFolders: __vars.setup.others }); await ApiClient.updateUserPolicy(__vars.setup.viewerId, policy); const after = await ApiClient.getUser(__vars.setup.viewerId); return { enableAll: after.Policy.EnableAllFolders, enabled: after.Policy.EnabledFolders.length };

steps.name: restricted
open the drawer to sign out
Sign out visible in the drawer
steps.waitFor: (() => { const a = document.querySelector('.mainDrawer .btnLogout'); if (!a) return false; const r = a.getBoundingClientRect(); return r.width > 0 && r.height > 0; })()

on the login page
sign in as viewer, in the same page load
viewer signed in
viewer's seeded bookmark
it is there, attached, and not available to viewer now (the Query's per-viewer field)
the video's id (webcheck substitutes top-level variables)

the page filtered to the video
the group: Unavailable with the placeholder, no poster request, the name unlinked, no Open title; the row: the badge, play disabled, no scissors, Rename and Edit and Delete
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-group')) return false; const g = c.querySelector('.jfbm-group'); const h = g.querySelector('.jfbm-group-header'); const row = g.querySelector('.jfbm-row'); const key = __vars.seed.ItemId.replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); return { badge: (h.querySelector('.jfbm-badge') || {}).textContent, poster: !!h.querySelector('img'), placeholder: !!h.querySelector('.jfbm-listitem-image .material-icons'), links: h.querySelectorAll('a').length, open: !!h.querySelector('.jfbm-open-title'), imageRequested: performance.getEntriesByType('resource').some(e => e.startTime > __vars.t0 && e.name.includes('/Items/' + key + '/Images/')), rowBadge: (row.querySelector('.jfbm-badge') || {}).textContent, playDisabled: row.querySelector('.jfbm-time-button').disabled, actions: [...row.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-actions button')].map(b => b.title), greyed: row.classList.contains('jfbm-row-detached'), count: r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-count').textContent }; })()

steps.name: as expected (Unavailable: attached, but the viewer can't open it; no poster request)

steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!location.hash.includes('view=flat') || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-row')) return false; const row = c.querySelector('.jfbm-row'); return { badge: (row.querySelector('.jfbm-badge') || {}).textContent, link: !!row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-item a'), item: row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-item').textContent, playDisabled: row.querySelector('.jfbm-time-button').disabled }; })()

steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy') || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-group')) return false; const g = c.querySelector('.jfbm-group'); const h = g.querySelector('.jfbm-group-header'); const key = __vars.seed.ItemId.replace(/-/g, '').toLowerCase(); const requested = performance.getEntriesByType('resource').some(e => e.startTime > __vars.t1 && e.name.includes('/Items/' + key + '/Images/Primary?fillHeight=120&quality=90')); if (!requested) return false; return { badge: !!h.querySelector('.jfbm-badge'), open: !!h.querySelector('.jfbm-open-title'), playDisabled: g.querySelector('.jfbm-row .jfbm-time-button').disabled }; })()
